ctx.x: Now in Lincoln we had this group, this band here and there was a fellow, a professor out of Boston by the name of Professor Jefferies, a very fine violinist. I've been master's name was - of it pretty soon - I'll think it was 57 (sentence doesn't make sense), a very fine musician. And we got together. Now in school there are no instruments bought for you. This is your own instrument. Jeff know City, Missouri, you knew. And, they had a pretty good band there.
